## TL;DR

Task #1041 is implemented end to end: after a successful Move to done, the PM agent writes one `summary.md` into `work/reports/<id>/`, queued fire-and-forget from close-out `cleanup()` so it can never block or fail the landing. The report is built from recorded facts only (task file, engineering rounds, review passes, activity log, sessions, linked tasks), validated for `## TL;DR` first and a ~2,000-word narrative cap, committed as task bookkeeping, and retried with `repoos summary <id>`. It surfaces in the drawer Report pane next to the engineering rounds, is documented in `user-docs/engineering-reports.md`, and is covered by core validation tests plus server generation/idempotency/failure tests. Scoped `repoos check` is the remaining gate before handoff.

## Work and rationale

**Explored before writing.** I mapped the existing report and close-out machinery first: a sample `work/reports/<id>/` directory (`round-*.json` beside `review-*.md`), `src/server/engineering-reports.ts` (validation + finalize pattern), `src/core/review-passes.ts` (pass bodies with agent/model metadata), `src/core/db.ts` (`getTaskSessions`, `SessionRecord`), `src/server/agents.ts` (`resolvePmAgent`, `runPrompt`, `recordOneShotSession`), and the API/CLI parity map (a new POST route needs a CLI command or exemption).

**Core module (`src/core/task-summary.ts`).** Dependency-light (only `report-paths.ts`) and table-testable: `summaryReportRelPath`, `TASK_SUMMARY_MAX_WORDS = 2000`, `countSummaryNarrativeWords` (cuts the trailing `## Changed files`/`Generated change summary` section before counting, the same convention engineering reports use), `validateTaskSummary` (the two acceptance checks: begins with `## TL;DR`, within budget), the `TaskSummaryFacts` family, `renderTaskSummaryFacts`, `buildTaskSummaryPrompt` (exact section order, never-invent-numbers rule, no file listing — the server appends it deterministically), and `formatTaskSummaryFileChanges`. No `report-paths.ts` change was needed: `isOwnReportPath` matches the whole `reports/<id>/` prefix, so `summary.md` is automatically task bookkeeping and landable/task-scope checks ignore it.

**Server module (`src/server/task-summary.ts`).** `collectTaskSummaryFacts` re-reads the task file fresh from disk (the passed task may predate the release stamp) and falls back to the in-memory body; rounds, review bodies, sessions and depends-on/dependent links complete the brief. `runTaskSummaryNow` resolves the PM agent through `resolvePmAgent` (which already applies the budget-allowlist pause fallback), runs one prompt, records usage with `sessionType: "summary"`, validates the narrative, appends the deterministic `## Changed files` listing computed from the merged commit, writes `summary.md`, and commits it with `commitFiles`. Every failure path records a visible `failed` status and returns it — the task's `done` status is never touched. `queueTaskSummary` is the fire-and-forget entry with an in-flight guard and advisory status under `<cacheDir>/task-summary/<id>.json`.

**Close-out hook.** `CloseOutOrchestrator.cleanup()` calls `queueTaskSummary` after `markTaskReleased`, inside its own try/catch with a warning log. The orchestrator holds no task list, so linked tasks ride empty on the automatic run and are enriched on retry — a deliberate trade-off documented at the call site.

**API, CLI, parity.** `GET /api/tasks/:id/summary` (always read from main, never a worktree copy) and `POST` (queue, 202, poll GET for terminal state). `repoos summary <id>` queues then polls up to 15 minutes, so backfill on already-done tasks and manual retry both work. Both routes added to `api-route-parity.ts` matchers (POST under control CLI, GET under UI-only).

**Drawer and docs.** The Report pane loads the summary alongside engineering rounds with the same generation guard, and shows a "Post-merge summary" block (existing `task-section-title`, `review-hint`, `ff-error`, `md-rendered` classes only) for the pending/failed states and the rendered report. `user-docs/engineering-reports.md` gained a `summary.md` section.

**Tests.** `src/core/task-summary.test.ts` covers the rel path, TL;DR requirement, over-long narrative rejection, file-changes exclusion from the count, and prompt section order. `src/server/__tests__/task-summary.test.ts` injects a fake PM runner and commit: generation writes/validates/commits and records done; a second run overwrites the same bytes (idempotent); a throwing runner records failed with the error while the task status stays put.

## Approaches tried

I considered putting path/validation helpers in `report-paths.ts` next to the round/review helpers, but a dedicated core module keeps prompt/facts logic together and mirrors the engineering-reports server/core split. I considered a word-count tolerance instead of a hard cap, and chose a hard cap with "about" in the message — the same posture as the 1,200-word engineering limit. For review bodies I reused `findReviewPassFile` + `parseDocument` rather than the `ReviewManager.readPass` path, since generation needs raw markdown for several passes, not one parsed report. For linked tasks I used `dependsOn` in both directions (depends-on + dependent) rather than text-mining follow-ups, which keeps the facts strictly recorded.

## Challenges and blockers

Two consecutive turns ended without a clean handoff (one cancelled check run, one network failure), so this turn re-verified the full worktree state before acting: clean tree, prior work committed as WIP checkpoints, no review reports and no queued handoff. The only known check failure so far was a typecheck error (`Agent` is not exported from `agents.ts`); I fixed it by deriving `PmAgent` from the resolver's return type, which the scoped check still needs to confirm. No shots are declared for the drawer change: the summary block renders only when a real `summary.md` or job status exists, which the preview board cannot seed, so any declared highlight would fail handoff under the strict missing-target rule; undeclared auto-captures degrade to warnings.

## Key learnings

- `isOwnReportPath` matching the whole `reports/<id>/` prefix means any new report kind in that directory is automatically close-out-safe — no scope-check edits needed.
- `resolveRoleAgent` already applies the allowlist pause fallback, so `resolvePmAgent` satisfies "pick the agent through the budget allowlist" with no extra work.
- The parity test forces the API shape decision early: POST summary needed `repoos summary <id>`; GET summary fit the existing UI-only matcher family.
- The task-drawer fetch pattern (generation-guarded loader + reset in the task watcher) extends cleanly to a second report kind without new store plumbing.
